params.name: count
params.description: Number of data partitions to create.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the volume to create data partitions for.

items.docs: Manually creates a data partition for a specific volume. This is typically done automatically by the Master when volume usage exceeds thresholds, but can be triggered manually when the cluster is frozen or for operational purposes.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the data partition to decommission.

params.name: addr
params.description: Address of the data node hosting the partition to migrate away from.

items.docs: Migrates a specific data partition from a given data node to another available data node. Used to drain a node before decommissioning or to rebalance data distribution.
